# SC Training

> > SC Training (formerly EdApp) is a mobile-first learning management system designed for frontline team training with AI-powered course creation, microlearning, and compliance tracking.

SC Training is SafetyCulture's mobile LMS platform that enables organizations to deliver rapid, engaging training to frontline workers through microlearning, gamification, and AI-assisted content creation. The platform supports multiple delivery formats including mobile apps, SMS, WhatsApp, and web access, with built-in analytics for compliance and performance tracking.

## Course Creation & Content Tools

- [Creator Tool](https://training.safetyculture.com/creator-tool): SC Training Creator Tool for rapid AI-powered course creation with 80+ templates.
- [Create with AI](https://training.safetyculture.com/ai-create): SC Training Create with AI feature for automated lesson and slide generation.
- [Microlearning Platform](https://training.safetyculture.com/microlearning): SC Training microlearning platform with built-in templates for quick course creation.
- [Rapid Refresh](https://training.safetyculture.com/rapid-refresh): SC Training Rapid Refresh quiz maker for microlearning knowledge reinforcement.
- [Content Library - Templates & Courses](https://training.safetyculture.com/course-library): SafetyCulture course library with customizable templates for workplace safety training.
- [Course Collections](https://training.safetyculture.com/course-collection): SC Training course collections covering hundreds of workplace training topics.

## Training Solutions by Use Case

- [Employee Onboarding Software](https://training.safetyculture.com/onboarding-solutions): SC Training employee onboarding solution for new hire mobile-first training.
- [Automated Compliance Training](https://training.safetyculture.com/automated-compliance-solutions): SC Training automated compliance training platform with AI-powered analytics.
- [SOP Training Software](https://training.safetyculture.com/sop-training-solutions): SC Training SOP training solution converting procedures into trackable mobile courses.
- [Product Knowledge Training](https://training.safetyculture.com/product-knowledge-training-solution): SC Training product knowledge training for frontline teams via mobile microlearning.
